title: Amigo da lua
direction: Progressão do próprio traço: cartoon simples → volume → ilustração detalhada → pintura refinada, mantendo Tiro adulto no banco e o vaga-lume.

variants.label: Comum
variants.detail: Tier 1 deliberately SIMPLE professional cartoon, matching the simplicity of image 2. Thick confident dark contours, few big graphic fur tufts, flat golden tan / steel-blue color blocks, only one shadow tone, simple brown eyes and nose, smooth untextured bench planks. Simplify environment drastically: retain left tree as large silhouette with a few broad leaf clumps, plain moon disc upper right, one soft distant house silhouette, plain grass. Remove flower beds, foreground flowers, lantern and all extra fireflies; retain exactly ONE little firefly before his nose. Large quiet color areas, minimal texture. Actual DOG linework/fur must be clearly simplified too, not just the background.

variants.label: Brilhante
variants.detail: Tier 2 polished standard 2D storybook cartoon matching image 2's rendering quality. Medium thin varied ink outlines, distinct layered fur LOCKS, 2-3 cel shaded tones giving rounded cheeks and paws, glossy brown eyes. Wood folds and a little grain, softly drawn tree foliage and distant village, one lantern at right. Sparse plain foreground grass, no flower clusters, one firefly near nose. Keep clean low-contrast background. Clearly richer dog drawing than flat cartoon but leave fine hair detail and nuanced painted materials for higher tiers.

variants.label: Holográfica
variants.detail: Tier 4 substantially more sophisticated premium PAINTED 2D KEY ART, matching image 2's delicate painterly craftsmanship. Same restrained scene props as rare: tree, moon, distant houses, right lantern, two small edge flower clusters, a few fireflies. NO added objects. Visibly upgrade actual DOG painting: exceptionally fine tapered selective contours, many delicate individual hair strand clusters over soft underfur, nuanced multi-layer cool blue moonlight / warm gold reflected light transitions, subtle ear-edge fuzz, whiskers, deep amber eyes with delicate reflected lights, richly painted velvety nose and soft muzzle. Fine weathered wood fibers, subtle metal patina, restrained leaf veins. Painterly lost edges and atmosphere soften background to foreground Tiro. Charming drawn storybook illustration with much more painted material realism than cel-shaded rare. NOT photo or 3D. NO rainbow, foil, glitter, halos or holographic filter. The clear jump from third to fourth is brushwork, fur microstructure, line delicacy and painted depth.
